verified_facts.text: The hotel is set within the restored Treasury Building of 1851.
verified_facts.excerpt: Set within the restored Treasury Building of 1851

verified_facts.text: The Treasury Building was the first purpose-built government office in Sydney.
verified_facts.excerpt: This building, with its intricate architectural façade, was the first purpose-built government office in Sydney.

verified_facts.text: The building houses the oldest operating lift in the Southern Hemisphere and the first vault in Australia.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our building houses the oldest operating lift in the Southern Hemisphere and the first vault in Australia.

verified_facts.text: The hotel sits in the dress circle of Circular Quay with views across the harbour.
verified_facts.excerpt: Nestled in the dress circle of Circular Quay with unparalleled views across the Harbour City

verified_facts.text: Guest rooms have views of Sydney Harbour Bridge, Sydney Opera House, the Royal Botanic Gardens or the city skyline.
verified_facts.excerpt: the luxury hotel’s exquisite guest rooms boast views of Sydney Harbour Bridge, Sydney Opera House, the Royal Botanic Gardens or the city skyline.

verified_facts.text: The heated indoor pool is 31 stories high with views of the Sydney Opera House through glass windows.
verified_facts.excerpt: Dive into refreshing waters and reenergize in our heated hotel pool. Floating 31 stories high, soak up sparking views of the Sydney Opera House through soaring glass windows.

verified_facts.text: Guests can walk to the Sydney Opera House, Sydney Harbour Bridge, the Royal Botanic Gardens and The Rocks.
verified_facts.excerpt: Walk to the business hubs and harbourside icons like the Sydney Opera House, Sydney Harbour Bridge, Sydney Royal Botanic Gardens and The Rocks historic quarter.

verified_facts.text: The Club InterContinental lounge has views of Sydney Harbour, the Opera House and the Royal Botanic Garden from high above.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our elevated club boasts views of Sydney Harbour, Sydney Opera House and Royal Botanic Garden from high above.

verified_facts.text: Aster is the hotel's rooftop bar on Level 32 with expansive harbour views and creative cocktails.
verified_facts.excerpt: Discover elevated drinking and dining at Aster, Sydney's exclusive rooftop bar. Indulge in expansive harbour views, creative cocktails, artful bar snacks and highly personalised service.

verified_facts.text: The Treasury is the hotel's lobby bar at the heart of the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: At the heart of the hotel, guests are invited to drink and dine at the new lobby bar, The Treasury

verified_facts.text: Rooms have a window-side chaise, a dedicated work station and Byredo bath amenities.
verified_facts.excerpt: Watch the world whirl by from the window-side chaise or work peacefully from the dedicated work station. Enjoy your best night’s sleep on a cloud bed, available in king or twin double sizes. Unwind with aromatic Byredo amenities

verified_facts.text: Suites include the Governor Opera Suite, Royal Opera Suite and Presidential Opera Suite.

verified_facts.excerpt: A calm palette of blues and grays enhances the connection to the harbor, and the marble-clad bathrooms feel opulent.

verified_facts.text: Condé Nast Traveler notes the hotel has no spa, so guests must go off-site for spa services.

verified_facts.excerpt: a stay here feels luxurious, thanks to attentive personnel who understand how to keep a hotel of this size running smoothly

verified_facts.text: Pets are not permitted, though guide dogs and service animals are welcome.

verified_facts.text: Condé Nast Traveler rates the hotel family friendly, with rooms bookable with two beds and a kids' food menu.
